name: TestCryptPower1WithArtificerDiscountToFixedCost
description:
Crypt Power 1 + Artificer: Combined discount allows alternative payment options.

This tests the scenario where discount can be applied to FIXED costs:
- Artificer provides +1 artifact discount
- Crypt provides +2 from its power
- Total discount = 3 (1 Artificer + 2 Crypt)
- Corrupt Altar costs 2 Death (fixed) + 3 any = 5 total
- With 3 discount applied to fixed (2) + any (1): 0 Death + 2 any remaining
- Player can pay 2 Calm instead of 2 Death

CRITICAL: The player HAS enough death to pay 2D, but CHOOSES to pay 2C.
This tests that the engine offers BOTH payment options:
1. Apply discount to "any" → pay 2D + 0A (fixed)
2. Apply discount to fixed + any → pay 0D + 2A (flexible)

BGA replay: https://boardgamearena.com/table?table=432930782

Two-stage placement:
- Stage 1: Use Crypt power (pay 1D activation cost)
- Stage 2: Place Corrupt Altar (pay 2 Calm - discount applied to fixed Death)
